item.title: China Tablet Shipments Fall 22.3% in Q3 as Costs Bite
item.description:
IDC reports China tablet shipments reached 6.6 million units in Q3 2026, down 22.3% year over year, the steepest decline since Q1 2020 and the first sub-7-million quarter in 12 quarters. Consumer shipments fell 24.9% amid price hikes, while commercial grew 9.6% but restocking is winding down; IDC expects cost pressure to persist through 2028.

原文标题：IDC：Q3 中国平板出货 660 万台同比降 22.3%

Why it matters：反映成本上涨对终端硬件需求的实质冲击，是观察 AI 终端与消费电子景气度的重要行业信号。

item.title: Alibaba's XuanTie Unveils XL-300 Interconnect IP with Double the Bandwidth
item.description:
Alibaba DAMO Academy's RISC-V brand XuanTie released XL-300, a high-throughput cache-coherent interconnect IP supporting up to 8 asynchronously connected cores, a 256-bit data width and up to 32MB of configurable L3 cache. It claims over 90% linear scaling across 8 cores and roughly double the bandwidth ceiling of the previous XL-200, adding Direct Memory Transfer to bypass conventional paths and relieve throughput bottlenecks caused by large L3 and high bus latency.

原文标题：玄铁发布 XL-300 互联 IP 带宽提升约 1 倍

Why it matters：RISC-V 服务器级互联 IP 的关键迭代，直接关系多核扩展效率与内存带宽上限。

item.title: STMicroelectronics Weighs Another Price Hike for January 2027
item.description:
STMicroelectronics plans to raise prices on some products effective January 1, 2027, its fourth round since 2026, citing rising materials, logistics and labor costs. Its CEO also warned that foundry and packaging capacity is shifting toward higher-margin AI products, creating supply bottlenecks for automotive and industrial chips.

item.title: Kioxia and Dell Build 157PB Object Storage in a Single Rack
item.description:
Kioxia and Dell have jointly delivered the industry's first 157PB object storage solution within a single standard 42U rack, combining 16 PowerEdge R7725xd servers with 640 Kioxia LC9 245.76TB QLC SSDs running Dell ObjectScale software-defined storage. Targeting AI training and other unstructured data workloads, the design sharply raises per-rack storage density without adding floor space, power or cooling demands.

item.title: Terence Tao Rebuilds Logic Teaching Game With Coding Agents
item.description:
Terence Tao used modern coding agents to rebuild QED, his 2018 interactive logic textbook, into Lean Grimoire, which can display an in-progress Lean proof of the player's game state and adds a fantasy-themed mode. The project demonstrates coding agents' practical productivity in modernizing math visualization and teaching tools, and Tao is seeking playtesting feedback to improve logic and Lean instruction.

item.title: Apache HTTP Server Hit by Critical HTTP/2 RCE Vulnerability
item.description:
A critical race condition, CVE-2026-119618, has been disclosed in Apache HTTP Server's mod_http2 assign_headers() function, enabling heap corruption and unauthenticated remote code execution. No public exploit or in-the-wild activity is reported yet, and mitigation includes disabling h2/h2c or restricting to HTTP/1.1.

原文标题：Apache HTTP Server 曝 HTTP/2 严重 RCE 漏洞

Why it matters：影响面极广的基础 Web 服务器组件出现可 RCE 的高危漏洞，运维与安全团队需立即排查。

item.title: Nvidia Board Hires Search Firm to Weigh Replacing Jensen Huang
item.description:
Bloomberg reports that Nvidia's board is working with an outside search firm on possible successors to Jensen Huang and is weighing an interim CEO. The move follows reports of a second relationship with an Nvidia employee, alongside an admitted relationship with a suspected Chinese intelligence asset; the board has opened an independent probe and shares fell about 8% after hours. Huang, the largest shareholder at roughly 3.6%, has rejected formal succession planning, and no named successor exists.

Why it matters：全球市值最高芯片公司的 CEO 继任危机，直接牵动 AI 算力供应链与行业格局。

item.description:

item.title: Google Ships A2UI 1.0 Letting Agents Render Native UI
item.description:
Google released A2UI 1.0, the first stable version of its open generative-UI protocol, in which agents describe what to display while each app renders it with its own native components, preserving low latency and native fidelity across web, Android, iOS and MCP hosts. The release adds bidirectional function calling and accessibility/metadata extensions, shipping renderers for React, Angular, Lit, Flutter, SwiftUI and Jetpack Compose plus Python, TypeScript and Dart agent SDKs; Atlassian, Bloomberg and ByteDance are already building on it.

原文标题：谷歌发布 A2UI 1.0 稳定版 智能体可直接生成原生 UI

Why it matters：智能体输出形态从纯文本转向原生 UI 的关键协议落地，且已有大厂实际采用，值得关注。

item.title: Claude Model Tier Choice Beats Maxing Out Reasoning Effort
item.description:
Artificial Analysis analyzed Anthropic's current Claude lineup on a cost-per-task basis and found that stepping up a model tier is more cost-effective than maxing out reasoning effort. Claude Opus 5.5 at xhigh scores 57, beating Sonnet 5.5 at max (55) while cutting cost per task by roughly 40% and time per task by about half; Fable 5.2 at high also outperforms Opus 5.5 at max. The pattern breaks at the cheapest tier, where every step up from Haiku 5.5 (max) costs more.

原文标题：Claude 模型层级选择比拉满推理更省钱

Why it matters：为 Claude 用户提供可量化的模型选型与成本权衡依据，具备直接决策参考价值。

item.title: Tool Use Nearly Doubles Model Scores on Visual Reasoning Benchmark
item.description:
Artificial Analysis reran its VIALS-AA life-sciences visual reasoning benchmark in a one-shot, no-tools format and found tool use nearly doubles scores on average, from about 25% to about 47%. Claude Fable 5.2 leads at 67% with tools but costs $4.20 per task and drops to 44% without them, while Claude Haiku 5.5 reaches 49% with tools at just $0.07 per task, beating the larger model's tool-free result at roughly a tenth of the cost. The takeaway is that cheaper models in an agent harness can outperform single-shot frontier models on both cost and performance.

原文标题：工具调用让模型视觉推理得分近乎翻倍

Why it matters：用对照实验量化了工具调用对视觉推理的增益，并给出成本与效果的权衡数据，对智能体架构选型有直接参考价值。

item.title: 亚马逊 HyperPod 新增静默数据损坏检测与恢复机制
item.description:

Why it matters：针对大规模训练中隐蔽且代价高昂的静默数据损坏，给出了可落地的检测与恢复工程方案。

item.title: 谷歌 DeepMind 发布 AlphaGenome 2 单细胞预测能力近乎翻倍
item.description:
谷歌 DeepMind 发布新一代基因组 AI 模型 AlphaGenome 2，采用条件模型架构，将组织、细胞类型与细胞状态作为输入，把预测粒度从组织级推进到单细胞级。模型基于超 1.07 亿个单细胞图谱训练，识别基因表达相关变异的能力接近上一代的两倍，在免疫细胞测试中致病因果变异识别率达 30%（上一代为 16%）。模型新增 DNA 甲基化预测并支持零样本泛化到未见细胞类型，已通过 API 向非商业研究开放。

Why it matters：这是 AI for Science 领域的重要节点，单细胞级变异识别能力近乎翻倍，并新增甲基化预测与零样本泛化，对基因组研究与药物发现具有实质价值。

item.title: 开源项目 Stela 让 x86 PC 运行 Apple Silicon 程序
item.description:
